title: Spiral Stitch round a hole: ring40-hole15-offset, round 7
description: PE-DESIGN 11.50's Spiral Stitch round a hole, round 7: a spiral from the outline inwards and one round the hole. PE: almost no band: pieces of 1243, 6, 1, 6 and 345 needles; 8 trims; one jump crosses the hole. OpenStitch joins its two spirals with one travel and does not sew the band pieces. Open, pinned at the internal tier: stitches (PE 1601, OpenStitch 1340); stitch-length-mean (PE 1.4903, OpenStitch 1.7322); stitch-length-max (PE 2.0396, OpenStitch 2.1401).

references.make: a 40 mm Circle with a 15 mm Circle (47,42.5)-(62,57.5) as hole, its centre 4.5 mm right; region Spiral Stitch on the outer shape. Hoop 100 x 100 mm page; line Not Sewn (Line); colour 800 EMBROIDERY RED; region attributes at their defaults (Density 2,0 line/mm, Run pitch 2,0 mm, Start Point first button) unless stated; nothing else in the design. Save As PES (default type, #PES0110). Status bar 39,30 x 39,70 mm, 1601 st.
